name: Rice Terraces of the Philippine Cordilleras
description: High in the mountains of northern Luzon, the Ifugao people have carved rice paddies into steep slopes, forming giant green staircases held up by stone and mud walls. Five clusters in Ifugao Province, including Batad and Bangaan, are protected. Water flows down from mountaintop forests through channels, and the terraces are still farmed by hand. Their age is debated, from 2,000 years to about 400.
